_comment: Kernels that do not reach HSACO, pinned by name so a NEW one fails CI while these known-broken ones do not. 'uncompilable' is an LLVM fatal error -- a defect in the kernel, not in portable IR. 'refused' is the Python lowerer correctly declining a wrong-arch-family kernel. Regenerate with: hsaco_parity --update-baseline
